thread:
anika: Oriona notified procurement: our reserved A100 order is being split across two legs. 70% on time, 30% delayed ~8-12 days. Impacts Dedicated commit for early May.

matt: Any PO updates? Can procurement push for consolidation?

partner-bot: PO OC-67920 update: 30 units A100-80GB. Leg1: 21 units ETA 2026-05-02. Leg2: 9 units ETA 2026-05-11.

olivia: Which Dedicated customers are in the risk window? We need targeted comms.

anika: Two customers tied to capacity pool P-Delta. One VIP; they'll notice reduced peak.

sam: Mitigation options: 1) Soft-fallback to A40 family for non-critical routes, 2) Borrow from spare reserved pool, 3) Offer temporary burst credits.

zach: Fallback requires routing policy change + quick eval on quality. I can canary 5% if we decide.

matt: Procurement reached out to Oriona for expedited second-leg. They offered to airfreight 3 units at extra cost. Need decision within 4 hours.

anika: Pros/cons: airfreight reduces VIP impact but costs $$; fallback keeps costs lower but may degrade perf. Which do we pick?

olivia: I'll prep customer note templates both for "capacity substitution" and for "short delay + mitigation".

sam: Proposed route policy snippet (preview):

```
route-policy: oc-fallback-may
match: pool == "P-Delta" && model.family == "a100"
fallback: ["a40-32gb-quant"]
canary: 0.05
```

zach: Dashboards: latency p95, token throughput, and eval quality will be monitored.

matt: Decision: approve airfreight for 3 units (reduce VIP impact). Procurement will absorb expedited fee from contingency.

partner-bot: Change logged: PO OC-67920 updated (3 units moved to leg1). Ticket OC-9914 created.

zach: Starting 5% canary on fallback now.

sam: Canary results (30m): latency +10% p95, output evals pass minimal thresholds. No spike in errors.

olivia: Sent comms to impacted customers with expected timelines and mitigations. One asked for a follow-up call.

anika: Good work. Keep ticket OC-9914 open until final delivery. We'll revisit if second-leg slips further. :thumbsup:
